hero.subtitle: We bring finance and technology together so your business grows with control — diagnostics, dashboards and financial leadership for SMEs and mid-sized companies.

dash.title: Executive dashboard
dash.alertText: Overdue receivables up 8% this month — prioritize collections.

problem.title: Your company has information. What it needs is clarity to decide.
problem.intro: Many companies sell, grow and operate every single day. But when it's time to decide, the numbers don't always tell a clear story.
problem.q1: Are you growing with real profitability?
problem.q2: Are your costs and expenses under control?
problem.q3: Does your cash flow sustain operations for the coming months?
problem.q4: Which indicators should management review every month?
problem.q5: Which areas need more financial order?
problem.q6: How do you turn information into concrete decisions?
problem.resultText: Financial clarity to make better decisions.

finance.title: Financial leadership to grow with order.
finance.intro: An executive, objective and practical view of your company's situation, designed for owners, general managers, finance and administrative leaders looking for more control and better decisions.

s1.title: Executive financial diagnostic
s1.text: We analyze your financial information to identify key issues, improvement opportunities and areas that need tighter control.

s2.title: Strategic financial leadership
s2.text: Fractional-CFO style support to back your decisions, strengthen planning and improve management follow-up.

s3.title: Profitability analysis
s3.text: We assess profitability by business line, unit, product or project.

s4.title: Cost and expense control
s4.text: We identify relevant patterns to support efficiency and control decisions.

s5.title: Cash flow
s5.text: We project and monitor your cash flow to anticipate needs and sustain operations.

s6.title: Financial KPIs
s6.text: We define the key indicators your management should track every month.

technology.title: Technology that turns your information into control.
technology.intro: We build digital solutions that connect your financial, commercial and operational information with visual, automated, easy-to-use tools. No unnecessary technical complexity.

s1.title: Corporate website
s1.text: Professional sites and landing pages to project trust and connect better with your clients.

s2.title: Web and mobile applications
s2.text: Tailor-made solutions to improve processes and centralize information.

s3.title: Executive dashboards
s3.text: We turn your data into visual boards of the key indicators.

s4.title: Report automation
s4.text: Fewer manual tasks, more accuracy and more time to decide.

s5.title: Data integration
s5.text: We connect information from different sources and systems.

s6.title: Applied artificial intelligence
s6.text: We apply AI and automation in a simple, useful, results-focused way.

why.title2: One goal: helping your company decide better.
why.intro: CJM Nexus combines financial expertise, strategic vision and tailor-made technology to support companies looking for more clarity and control.

r1.title: 15+ years of experience
r1.text: Our founding team brings more than 15 years of financial experience in analysis, control, planning and decision-making.

r2.title: Clients worldwide
r2.text: We have supported more than 100 clients across Latin America, the United States and Europe.

r3.title: Tailor-made solutions
r3.text: We don't work with generic formulas. We design every solution around your information, structure, goals and priorities.

why.closing: Clear finance. Useful technology. Decisions with control.

p1.title: We talk
p1.text: We talk about your company's situation, your priorities and your main financial or technology challenges.

p2.title: We identify opportunities
p2.text: Together we identify the highest-impact opportunities to organize, control and decide better.

p3.title: We propose a path
p3.text: We propose a path forward: a diagnostic, financial leadership or a tailor-made technology solution. No commitment.

cta.title2: toward a clearer, more organized company that's ready to grow.
cta.text: Let's talk about turning your numbers into clearer decisions. Book a free 20-minute meeting.
